stories.title: White Sox shut down Guardians to win Game 1 of ALDS
stories.summary: The White Sox shut out the Guardians to win Game 1 of their AL Division Series 3-0 on Saturday.

stories.title: Fever GM defends fanbase: Attacks have no basis in reality, must stop
stories.summary: General manager Amber Cox defended the Fever fanbase during her end-of-season news conference, saying the "attacks on our fanbase have no basis in reality."

stories.title: Sources: Pitt QB Heintschel out for season with torn ACL
stories.summary: Pitt quarterback Mason Heintschel, one of the top young quarterbacks in college football, will miss the remainder of the season with a torn ACL, sources told ESPN on Saturday.

stories.title: Russell outduels Taylor in battle of SEC headliners as Alabama rolls
stories.summary: Mississippi State's Kamario Taylor entered Saturday as the SEC's top Heisman Trophy candidate through four games, but Alabama's Keelon Russell catapulted past him as the sophomore threw three touchdowns in the Crimson Tide's 56-23 win over the Bulldogs.

stories.title: Michigan, Underwood again underwhelm as Gophers hoist Little Brown Jug
stories.summary: Minnesota's defense overwhelmed quarterback Bryce Underwood as the Golden Gophers beat Michigan for the first time since 2014 with a 20-14 victory.
